actions.action: Check soil moisture 2 inches deep with a finger
Water only when soil is dry at 2 inches
Empty standing water from bowl or saucer
Alternatively group the plant with other plants
Alternatively set up a pebble tray with the pot above the water line
Move the plant back closer to the window out of direct sun
Add a sheer curtain to the window
Position the plant lamp about 30 cm above the leaves and run it 10-12 hours a day (turn on/off)
Slide the plant out of the pot and inspect the roots
If roots are black or mushy, trim the rotten parts with clean scissors
If rot is found, repot in fresh well-draining mix in a pot with a drainage hole

reason: The answer identifies post-repot stress worsened by wet soil and low light, and explicitly tells the owner to increase light and run the plant lamp, which is the fix that worked; nothing it suggests is likely to hurt the plant.
